Messages.Author: John Whelan
Messages.Body:
Q: Can one play Mask of 1K Faces multiple times on a single action,
provided there are multiple vampires with obfuscate to play the card?

Example:
Agrippina is bleeding. Then Tusk plays Mask to say HE's really
doing it. Then Grendel plays another to say HE's really doing it. Then
Agrippina plays a 3rd one to say that it was really her all along. Each
vampire plays the card only once, so this does not seem to violate the
rule that no minion can play an identical action modifier on a single action.

Q: Can one use the superior version, even if one does not need the
stealth?

(For instance, in the above example, does the action end up at +3 stealth
by the time it gets back to Agrippina, even if, up until this point, no
one has declared a block.)

Messages.Author: John Whelan
Messages.Body:
Hardrock Llewynyth (hard...@speakeasy.org) wrote:
: Thus saith John Whelan the Unworthy, in the Year of Our Lord 22 Dec 1996 00:38:33 -0500 :
: > Q: Can one play Mask of 1K Faces multiple times on a single action,

: > provided there are multiple vampires with obfuscate to play the card?

: Yup. Remember, Mask is an *action* card, not an action modifier; so each
: vampire is taking a seperate action. Handy if you are playing a
: combination bleed deck--eg, Pre/Dom (Malks/FoS--Social Charm, Aire of
: Elation, then Mask to a Malk for Conditioning or Foreshadowing
: Destruction)--or stealth combat (Nos or Ass), switch the action from a
: small, weak vamp (or caitiff) to a large heavy-hitter.

What? Both the Jyhad and V:tES editions have "action modifier"
symbols. Was there a ruling to change this?
Also, I thought that one of the restrictions on Mo1kF was that a
vampire could not use it to take over an action he is incapable of
performing. Thus your combination bleed deck would be unworkable.

: > Q: Can one use the superior version, even if one does not need the
: > stealth?

: If no one attempts to block, then you cannot throw stealth. If you don't
: need the stealth, then why worry about it? Mask works just the same at
: inferior.

Hmmm. I'm not sure this is absolutely true. There are lots of
"action" cards that add stealth before the opponent has a chance to
block, including all the political actions. If it IS an action card, then
why is playing it at superior any different from playing a political
action, with its automatic +1 stealth.
I'm not worried about it, just curious. It is a question that
might conceivably come up in playing a deck I've designed.
I'm interested in this card because it is one of the few stealth
cards that can be burned to prevent hand jam if you do not need the
stealth. Another such card is Spying Mission.

J.B.Whelan

Messages.Author: Hardrock Llewynyth
Messages.Body:
Thus saith John Whelan the Unworthy, in the Year of Our Lord 22 Dec 1996 00:38:33 -0500 :
> Q: Can one play Mask of 1K Faces multiple times on a single action,
> provided there are multiple vampires with obfuscate to play the card?

Yup. Remember, Mask is an *action* card, not an action modifier; so each
vampire is taking a seperate action. Handy if you are playing a
combination bleed deck--eg, Pre/Dom (Malks/FoS--Social Charm, Aire of
Elation, then Mask to a Malk for Conditioning or Foreshadowing
Destruction)--or stealth combat (Nos or Ass), switch the action from a
small, weak vamp (or caitiff) to a large heavy-hitter.

> Q: Can one use the superior version, even if one does not need the
> stealth?

If no one attempts to block, then you cannot throw stealth. If you don't
need the stealth, then why worry about it? Mask works just the same at
inferior.

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
In article <59ku1m$j...@dorsai.dorsai.org>,
jbwh...@dorsai.org (John Whelan) wrote:
>
> Hardrock Llewynyth (hard...@speakeasy.org) wrote:
> : Thus saith John Whelan the Unworthy, in the Year of Our Lord 22 Dec 1996

00:38:33 -0500 :
> : > Q: Can one play Mask of 1K Faces multiple times on a single action,
> : > provided there are multiple vampires with obfuscate to play the card?
>
> : Yup. Remember, Mask is an *action* card, not an action modifier; so each
> : vampire is taking a seperate action. Handy if you are playing a
> : combination bleed deck--eg, Pre/Dom (Malks/FoS--Social Charm, Aire of
> : Elation, then Mask to a Malk for Conditioning or Foreshadowing
> : Destruction)--or stealth combat (Nos or Ass), switch the action from a
> : small, weak vamp (or caitiff) to a large heavy-hitter.
>

> What? Both the Jyhad and V:tES editions have "action modifier"
> symbols. Was there a ruling to change this?

Ther is none. Mask is and always has been a modifier.
But, each vampire with superior obfuscate can play one Mask to give the
acting minion +1 steath.

> Also, I thought that one of the restrictions on Mo1kF was that a
> vampire could not use it to take over an action he is incapable of
> performing. Thus your combination bleed deck would be unworkable.

No, the restriction is that a minion cannot use the Mask to take over an
action that he is explicitly forbidden from doing (like hunting with
Talbot's Chainsaw in hand). Also, you cannot take over another minion's
inherent action (like the Garou's +1 stealth rush).

Taking over an action that you lack the skill (or even the clan) to perform
is allowed.

> : > Q: Can one use the superior version, even if one does not need the

> : > stealth?
>
> : If no one attempts to block, then you cannot throw stealth.

Correct. Stealth cannot be added to an action (or minion) unless it is
needed.

> I'm interested in this card because it is one of the few stealth
> cards that can be burned to prevent hand jam if you do not need the
> stealth. Another such card is Spying Mission.

Spying mission cannot be burned needlessly, you either use it for the (needed)
stealth (inferior), or you use it at the end of a successful bleed action
(for it's full effect)(superior).

"Sorrow" <cbo...@apdi.net> writes:
>> Taking over an action that you lack the skill (or even the clan) to
>perform
>> is allowed.

>Would the action be successful? If a minion started out an action that
>required a specific clan to play, would a masked minion not of that clan be
>able to continue the action to a successful conclusion?

Yes, the action would be successful.
A Nos could Mask an recruit Political Ally from a Ventrue, and the ally
would come into play if the action was ultimately successful.
